type.description: The message name — <name> in the routing key.

domain.description: The owning domain — <domain> in the routing key. A segment with no Manager owner: the floor app is a Client, and a segment does not acquire a Manager by existing.

kind.description: Which exchange carries this message. Never reaches the routing key.

ts.description: When the sender published this message, ISO-8601 UTC.

target.description: The machine reporting — the <machine> routing segment, the sender's Routing:MachineName. Required: the floor speaks only for its own machine. A machine name, not an id: nothing enforces uniqueness on the value.

reason.description: Why the floor returned: 'commanded' — a show arrived; 'expired' — the hide deadline passed.

BackdropShown.description: The floor is back, and why: a show command, or the hide deadline expiring. The return after an expiry is the room proving the floor is alive.
